verses.text: The priests, who are Levites, and in fact the whole tribe of Levi, will have no share of land in Israel. They will live on the food offerings made to the LORD by fire, which is their share.
They will have no land among the other tribes. The LORD himself is their share, as he promised them.
This is what the priests may have from the people who offer a sacrifice, whether it is a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.
Also give them the first part of your grain, new wine, and olive oil, and the first wool cut from your sheep.
For the LORD your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and serve in the LORD's name always.
A Levite may move from any town in Israel where he is living and come, because he truly wants to, to the place the LORD will choose.
There he may serve in the name of the LORD his God, like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the LORD.
He must receive an equal share of the food, even if he also has money from selling his family property.
When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, do not learn to copy the hateful ways of the nations there.
Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, or who tries to tell the future, or reads signs, or uses magic, or casts spells,
or puts curses on people, or talks with spirits, or is a witch, or tries to speak with the dead.
The LORD hates anyone who does these things. It is because of these hateful practices that the LORD your God is driving out those nations ahead of you.
You must be completely faithful to the LORD your God.
The nations you will drive out listen to people who do magic and try to tell the future. But the LORD your God has not allowed you to do that.
The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people. You must listen to him.

This is what you asked the LORD your God for at Mount Sinai, on the day you were gathered there. You said, "Do not let us hear the voice of the LORD our God again or see this great fire any more, or we will die."
The LORD said to me, "What they have said is good.
I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their own people. I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
I myself will hold responsible anyone who does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name.
But if a prophet dares to speak in my name something I have not commanded him to say, or speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet must die."
You may wonder, "How can we know whether a message has not come from the LORD?"
If a prophet speaks in the LORD's name and what he says does not happen or come true, then that message is not from the LORD. That prophet has spoken out of pride. Do not be afraid of him.
